tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows show dependence beyond an uninformative static snapshot, but do not identify a stable quantitative law from the two authorized temporal mechanisms. A fine trajectory batch is the only available probe suited to resolve that ambiguity before fitting and confirming a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a single-mode Maxwell stress-decay law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed outputs do not show a consistent proportionality to the before/after input difference across horizons.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a mean-reverting OU snapshot law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The mixed output signs and variation with both before/after inputs are not explained by the supplied snapshot form; current rows do not establish which mechanism dominates.
It is explicitly a nuisance auxiliary measurement and is not needed to discriminate the temporal response.
